{{Short description|List of works published by American statistician Charles Roy Henderson}}
The '''Charles Roy Henderson bibliography''' contains a list of works published by American statistician [[Charles Roy Henderson]] (1911–1989). His corpus covers his 40-year professional career from his PhD thesis in 1948 until his death in 1989. It includes three of his most important scientific publications:{{r|Searle1991|VanVleck1998}} ''Estimation of Variance and Covariance Components'' (1953),{{sfn|Henderson|1953}} ''The estimation of environmental and genetic trends from records subject to culling'' (1959, with [[Oscar Kempthorne]], [[Shayle R. Searle]], and C. M. von Krosigk),{{sfn|Henderson|Kempthorne|Searle|von Krosigk|1959}} and ''A simple method for computing the inverse of a numerator relationship matrix used in prediction of breeding values'' (1976).{{sfn|Henderson|1976}}
